description: Complete full internationalization by adding Marathi (mr.json) translation file, applying translate pipe to ALL user-facing text across all components, adding language selector to navbar, and storing language preference in User model for authenticated users. @ngx-translate is installed and configured. en.json and hi.json exist and are complete. es.json (Spanish) should be replaced with mr.json (Marathi).
steps: 1. Read existing translation files: frontend/src/assets/i18n/en.json (complete reference), frontend/src/assets/i18n/hi.json (verify completeness)

2. Create frontend/src/assets/i18n/mr.json by copying en.json structure. For this implementation, use placeholder English text with comment '/* TODO: Add Marathi translations */' at top. This allows feature to be functional immediately while translations can be added later
4. Add preferredLanguage field to User model at frontend/server/models/User.js: preferredLanguage: { type: String, enum: ['en', 'hi', 'mr'], default: 'en' }

5. Create backend endpoint in frontend/server/routes/users.js: PUT /api/users/profile/language with body { userId, language }. Controller should validate language enum and update user.preferredLanguage
6. Update frontend/src/app/service/auth.service.ts: after successful login, if user.preferredLanguage exists, call TranslateService.use(user.preferredLanguage). Inject TranslateService in constructor

7. Create LanguageService at frontend/src/app/service/language.service.ts if it doesn't exist, or update existing one: add setLanguage(lang) method that: (a) calls translateService.use(lang), (b) stores in localStorage, (c) if user is authenticated, calls PUT /api/users/profile/language
8. Update navbar language selector in frontend/src/app/Component/navbar/navbar.component.html: ensure dropdown includes English, Hindi, Marathi options. Bind to languageService.setLanguage()

9. Audit ALL component templates for untranslated text. Apply translate pipe to: landing-page (hero title, search labels), selectbus-page (filters, bus details), payment-page (payment methods, form labels), profile-page (section titles, form labels), my-trip (section headers, booking details labels, button text), navbar (all menu items), footer (links and text)

10. Add missing translation keys to all 3 i18n files: Check each component template, identify any text not yet using translate pipe, add corresponding keys to NAV.*, HOME.*, BOOKING.*, PAYMENT.*, PROFILE.*, COMMUNITY.*, REVIEWS.*, NOTIFICATIONS.*, MAP.*, ERRORS.* sections

11. For booking-related labels (departure, arrival, fare, seats, passenger, status), add BOOKING.DEPARTURE_TIME, BOOKING.ARRIVAL_TIME, BOOKING.FARE, BOOKING.SEATS, BOOKING.PASSENGER_COUNT, BOOKING.STATUS_CONFIRMED, BOOKING.STATUS_PENDING, BOOKING.STATUS_COMPLETED, BOOKING.STATUS_CANCELLED keys

12. Test language switching: verify all text updates when language changes, verify preference persists in localStorage for anonymous users, verify preference is saved to user profile for authenticated users and restored on next login
acceptance_criteria: mr.json (Marathi) translation file exists with same structure as en.json
es.json is removed from i18n directory
User model has preferredLanguage field with enum validation
PUT /api/users/profile/language endpoint exists and updates user.preferredLanguage
Language selector in navbar includes English, Hindi, and Marathi
ALL user-facing text in all components uses translate pipe with appropriate keys
Switching language updates all visible text immediately
Anonymous users: language preference persists in localStorage across page reloads
Authenticated users: language preference saves to profile and restores on next login
No hardcoded user-facing text remains in any template (except loading placeholders)
verification: cd /Users/kedarpatil/Documents/kedar/tedbus_project/REDBUS-CLONE-MEAN-main-3/.worktrees/tedbus-complete-upgrade/frontend && npm run build -- produces no TypeScript errors
Start backend and frontend without signing in, change language to Hindi, verify all text translates, reload page, verify Hindi persists
Sign in with Google, change language to Marathi, verify all text updates, sign out and sign in again, verify Marathi is restored
Navigate to every page (home, search, booking, payment, profile, my-trips, community) and verify all text uses translations
Verify PUT /api/users/profile/language responds with success and updates user document in MongoDB
